body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{frontier}}\), determine explicit rate functions \(\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\) such that \(R_d(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(E_{d,\alpha}(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\) uniformly over every legal \(K=K_N\), including exact fixed-\(K\) logarithms and every transition. The lower-bound branch must choose the finite-support simultaneous family so that \(\Delta_{N,K}\) matches the claimed rate, \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\le1/4\), and \(\mathfrak g_{\mathrm{rem}}\ge0\) certifies the endpoint separation against every rematching column; its ordered low-versus-high version must also support the one-sided length converse. The upper-bound branch must construct a computable estimator and uniformly honest lower bound attaining the respective rates, or prove a sharper shared-geometric dual bound if the simultaneous family cannot achieve the required separation.
body.justification: The theorem-level kernel is the exact all-arm estimation and honest-length frontier, not merely another plug-in bound.
body.gap: Gao--Ge--Qian stop at minimax optimality for \(d\le4\); Manole--Niles-Weed leave logarithmic slack for two margins; no closer source found in the 2026 search subsumes the arbitrary-margin endpoint problem.
body.consumer: The frontier gives a principled uncertainty deduction for every empirical multiworld second-moment lower endpoint, including the scholarship-incentive audit.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine matching all-estimator and ordered one-sided lower bounds in the region below the proved large-arm transition, including the exact fixed-\(K\) logarithm and the factor of \(K\) between the two-margin lower modulus and the empirical-MOT upper modulus.
obligation.obstruction: The current nonparametric converse is a two-margin embedding of order \(K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d}\), whereas the proved plug-in term is \(K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\). Neither the simultaneous-rematching certificate nor a sharper aggregate upper bound is available, and the cited two-margin theorem itself leaves logarithmic slack. The Bernoulli ordered pair proves only the root-\(N\) honest-length component.
obligation.attempted: The exact residual cap, optimal-support diameter, empirical interpolation bound, two-margin reduction, Bernoulli testing pair, large-\(K\) point and length converses, and certified grid algorithm were proved. Sparse-active-arm, fixed-dimensional orthogonal, parity, and Bernoulli constructions do not close the remaining arm-count and logarithmic gaps.
obligation.partial_result:
The closed part of the frontier is
\[
c_d\max\{N^{-1/2},K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d}\}
\le R_d(N,K)
\le C_d\left[N^{-1/2}+\min\{r/K^2,K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\}\right].
\]
Moreover, both \(R_d(N,K)\) and \(E_{d,\alpha}(N,K)\) are of exact order \(N^{-1/2}\) whenever \(K\ge c_0N^{1/4}\), and the explicit mean-floor lower confidence bound is uniformly honest there with excess length \(O_{d,\alpha}(N^{-1/2})\). A rational-grid empirical MOT procedure returns a primal--dual bracket of any rational width \(\epsilon>0\) in time polynomial in \(N\) and \((K/\epsilon)^d\) for fixed \(d\).
